negative parenting practices are associated with more behavioral problems, less adaptive functioning in parents, less social support and lower quality of life.

the importance of positive parenting practices for the well-being of parents, and for the socialization of children with ADHD, as well as for the development of their social competence.
the relationship between the use of positive parenting practices and the quality of life and support of caregivers of children and adolescents who have ADHD.
the relationship between parenting styles, quality of life, social support and mental health, in parents of children and adolescents diagnosed with ADHD.

the quality of parenting practices is related to the quality of life and mental health of parents of children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
the quality of parenting practices has a strong relationship with the adaptive functioning of the child with ADHD and the quality of life of the caregiver.

parenting styles and practices have an important influence on children’s behavioral problems.
